<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,minimum-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#060b19"><title>Киира — проверка платформера v0.2</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-user-select:none!important;user-select:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}*::before,*::after{-webkit-user-select:none!important;user-select:none!important;-webkit-touch-callout:none!important}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020510;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:none;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}#game{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}canvas{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;display:block}#status{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:40%;color:#e0faff;text-align:center;font-size:16px;padding:15px;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 2px 6px black;z-index:3}#controls{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:5}.pad{position:absolute;width:min(26vw,125px);height:min(26vw,125px);max-height:26vh;aspect-ratio:1;border:2px solid #85c9e5aa;border-radius:50%;background:#122f46a9;box-shadow:0 0 16px #0af5 inset,0 0 8px #0008;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none}.pad:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:34%;height:34%;border:2px solid #aeecff;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);left:calc(50% + var(--jx,0px));top:calc(50% + var(--jy,0px));background:#2f86b5a8;pointer-events:none}.pad:after{content:attr(data-label);position:absolute;left:50%;top:-19px;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;color:#cef9ff;font-size:11px;opacity:.85;pointer-events:none}#move{left:2.4%;bottom:5%}#jump{position:absolute;right:2.4%;bottom:8%;width:min(10vw,67px);height:min(10vw,67px);max-height:17vh;max-width:17vh;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ffb9e7;background:#752d75b8;color:#fff;font:bold clamp(10px,1.6vw,15px) Arial;box-shadow:0 0 21px #f13ca77a;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none}#jump:active{background:#d839ab}#menu{position:absolute;right:9px;top:9px;z-index:6;padding:6px 9px;background:#0d2437ad;color:#dbf8ff;border:1px solid #3d8ba5a8;border-radius:6px;font:11px Arial;pointer-events:auto}#hint{position:absolute;bottom:2px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:#c1e7f0ad;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;z-index:4;pointer-events:none}#dbg{display:none;position:absolute;right:9px;top:45px;background:#081625ec;padding:8px;color:white;border:1px solid #307b95;border-radius:8px;z-index:6;max-width:220px;font:12px Arial;pointer-events:auto}#dbg label{display:block;margin:7px 0}#dbg input{width:100%;accent-color:cyan}#dbg button{font-size:12px;background:#12425d;color:#fff;border:1px solid #59bfe9;border-radius:5px;padding:5px}
@media (orientation:portrait){#status{top:30%}#move{bottom:7%}#jump{bottom:11%}}
</style></head><body>
<div id="game"></div><div id="status">Загрузка кадров и игрового движка…</div>
<div id="controls"><div id="move" class="pad" data-label="СКАНЕР / ХОД"></div><button id="jump">ПРЫЖОК</button></div>
<button id="menu">ФИЗИКА ⚙</button><div id="dbg"><label>Скорость: <span id="speedV">205</span><input id="speed" type="range" min="100" max="320" value="205"></label><label>Прыжок: <span id="jumpV">420</span><input id="power" type="range" min="260" max="590" value="420"></label><label>Гравитация: <span id="gravV">900</span><input id="grav" type="range" min="500" max="1450" value="900"></label><button id="reset">Сбросить позицию</button></div><div id="hint">Стик: слегка — сканер, сильнее — ход · кнопка — прыжок</div>

const ASSETS={"bg":"data:image/png;base64,
